description: Java class providing a compatibility layer for different API versions of a notes synchronization service in an Android application. It handles API calls related to notes, focusing on version-specific behavior and exposing methods for CRUD operations, fetching settings, and managing notes via Retrofit API interfaces.

classes.name: NotesAPI
classes.description: A class that manages communication with the Notes API, supporting multiple API versions (0.2 and 1.0) through internal API interface instances and providing methods for notes management such as fetching, creating, updating, and deleting notes.

classes.name: NotesAPI.Note_0_2
classes.description: A static inner class representing the Note data structure for API version 0.2, with JSON serialization annotations.

methods.name: NotesAPI
methods.description: Constructor initializing the API version to use based on the preferredApiVersion parameter, setting up the appropriate Retrofit API interface.

methods.name: getNotes
methods.description: Fetches notes modified after a given timestamp, delegating to the appropriate API version's method.

methods.name: getNotesIDs
methods.description: Retrieves a list of note IDs from the server.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Fetches a specific note by remote ID.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note on the server.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by its remote ID.

methods.name: editNote
methods.description: Edits an existing note, ensuring remote ID is present.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID.

methods.name: getSettings
methods.description: Retrieves notes settings; only supported in API version 1.0.

methods.name: putSettings
methods.description: Updates notes settings; only supported in API version 1.0.
